statement: The pinned kernel and SDL direct-wired selection paths do not require an actual USB interface for 28de:1302, so linux.uhid.usb is provisionally plausible for the playable tier. This is an inference, not acceptance: feature exchanges, hidraw enumeration, driver binding, Steam Input listing, first input delivery and cleanup remain unmeasured. P1 on an owner-selected host (D9) is still required; source acceptance alone does not prove every control or output works.

applicability.scope: Consumer evidence only; no physical observation or device-side protocol promotion
